exercises.name: Front Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.pose_description_uk: Стоячи прямо, дві гантелі підняті вперед до рівня плечей, лікті трохи зігнуті.

source_english.description: Front Raise (Dumbbell) raises dumbbells forward to a controlled shoulder-height range without leaning back.
instructions: Stand tall holding the dumbbells in front of the thighs with a soft bend in the elbows.
Raise the arms forward to about shoulder height without leaning back.
Pause briefly with the shoulders down.
Lower slowly to the starting position.
source_english.safety_note: Use a light load and stop before painful shoulder height.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.pose_description_uk: Нижня фаза присідання: одна гантеля біля грудей, стопи повністю спираються на землю.

source_english.description: Goblet Squat bends the hips and knees through a front-loaded squat path before returning to standing.
instructions: Stand with one dumbbell at the chest and feet about shoulder-width apart.
Bend the hips and knees to the controlled depth while keeping both feet planted.
Keep knees tracking over the toes and pause at the endpoint.
Drive through the whole foot to stand and reset.
source_english.safety_note: Choose a depth and load that keep the feet, knees, and spine stable.

exercises.name: Lateral Leg Raises
exercises.pose_description_uk: Лежачи на боці на килимку, верхня пряма нога трохи піднята; таз не розвернутий.

source_english.description: A lateral leg raise lifts one straight leg away from the body while the pelvis stays stacked.
instructions: Lie on your side with the lower leg bent or straight for support and the upper leg long.
Brace the abdomen and keep the toes facing forward.
Lift the upper leg directly away from the body without rolling the pelvis back.
Lower the leg slowly and repeat, then switch sides.
source_english.safety_note: Move slowly and stop if the outer hip pinches or the pelvis cannot stay stacked.

exercises.name: Lunge
exercises.pose_description_uk: Нижня фаза випаду вперед: руки на стегнах, переднє коліно близько 90°, корпус прямий.

source_english.description: Step forward into a bodyweight split stance, lower under control, and push back to standing.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips.
Take a big step forward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position.
Bend your right knee to about 90 degrees, keeping your knee aligned with your ankle.
Push off with your right foot and return to the starting position.
Repeat with your left leg, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
form_cues: Track the knees with the toes.
Keep the chest and trunk controlled.
source_english.safety_note: Use a depth and load that allow a stable knee and hip path.

exercises.pose_description_uk: Лежачи на спині, долоні під сідницями; дві прямі ноги підняті до майже вертикального положення.

source_english.description: From the floor, raise the straight legs toward vertical while keeping the lower back controlled.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Place your hands under your glutes for support.
Engage your core and lift your legs off the ground, raising them towards the ceiling.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
source_english.safety_note: Use light resistance and stop if the shoulder cannot move smoothly.

exercises.name: Reverse Curl (Barbell)
depicted_equipment: one straight barbell with simple balanced plates
exercises.pose_description_uk: Стоячи, проста штанга піднята до верхньої фази згинання; хват зверху, плечі нерухомі.

source_english.description: Reverse Curl (Barbell) curls the palms-down weight toward the shoulders while keeping the upper arms still.
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Keep your upper arms stationary and exhale as you curl the barbell upward, contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the barbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the barbell is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale as you slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
form_cues: Use a steady squeeze at the top.
source_english.safety_note: Choose a load that keeps the wrists and elbows aligned without momentum.

exercises.name: Sit Up
exercises.pose_description_uk: Верхня фаза sit-up: коліна зігнуті, стопи на килимку, руки легко торкаються потилиці.

source_english.description: A sit-up curls the torso from the floor until the trunk rises, then lowers back to the mat.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat, and hands lightly behind the head.
Brace the abdominals and curl the shoulders and torso toward the knees.
Raise the trunk until the torso is upright enough to complete the sit-up without pulling the neck.
Lower the spine gradually until the shoulders return to the floor.
form_cues: Lead with the ribs, not the head.
source_english.safety_note: Use a shorter range if the lower back cannot stay comfortable on the descent.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
exercises.pose_description_uk: Нижня контрольована фаза румунської тяги: таз назад, коліна трохи зігнуті, гантелі близько до гомілок.

source_english.description: Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell) hinges the hips back with the weight close to the legs until the hamstrings stretch, then stands by driving the hips forward.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbells towards the ground, allowing your knees to bend slightly.
Lower the dumbbells until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then push through your heels and engage your glutes to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
